access_basis_note: Compensation fork 3 (universal vs conditional access). 'gated' = the suffering-conditional branch (canonical term, supersedes 'conditional'). Optional per node; absence = not-applicable. Pick per-objection which standing-point the node argues from; do not silently mix across adjacent nodes.
